name: MHS - Shipments of new manufactured homes by state
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau / HUD (shipment counts produced by IBTS)
what_it_covers: Annual shipments of new HUD-Code homes by state of destination
limitations: HUD-Code only; no manufacturer detail; table page stops at 2022 so newer years come from SRC04

name: MHS - Average sales price by state
what_it_covers: Average sales price of new manufactured homes by state; square footage and characteristics by region
limitations: Characteristics only at region level

name: MHS - Public Use File (microdata)
what_it_covers: Home-level records with PII removed (price; size; sections; placement attributes)
limitations: No state or manufacturer identifiers expected - confirm in PUF documentation

name: MHI Monthly Economic Report
what_it_covers: Monthly production and shipments by state and census division; single vs multi-section; plants and corporations (national)
years_available: Recent years (PDF archive on MHI site)
limitations: Industry association; PDF tables need extraction; fills the post-2022 gap in SRC01

name: MHI Plant List
what_it_covers: Every active HUD-Code plant: plant code; manufacturer; city; state; closures/changes (147 plants as of 1/31/2026)
limitations: HUD-Code plants only; brand names not parent corporations; no capacity

name: HUD Office of Manufactured Housing Programs
what_it_covers: Federal HUD-Code program; plant certification via inspection agencies; program reports
format_access: Web; possible records request for plant certification list
limitations: No public plant download confirmed - use as cross-check for SRC05

name: Census Survey of Construction - construction method
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau (summarized annually by NAHB)
what_it_covers: Single-family completions by method: site-built; modular; panelized/precut (2024: ~13k modular and ~15k panelized of 1.019M)
format_access: Census SOC tables; NAHB Eye on Housing summaries
limitations: Region only - no state detail; single-family only

name: Modular Building Institute industry reports
what_it_covers: Permanent modular construction market size; producer counts; sector shares
limitations: Commercial-leaning; proprietary; limited geography

name: Colorado DOH Factory-Built Structures program
what_it_covers: Certified manufacturers by facility and structure type (FB residential; FBNR non-residential incl. multifamily; TH tiny homes); registered sellers/installers
format_access: Registered Account Search portal (manual export or records request)
limitations: No bulk download confirmed; ask DOH for a facility list (dola_manufacturedbuildings@state.co.us)

name: Other state modular/factory-built programs
publisher: Individual states (example: New York certified entities)
what_it_covers: State-licensed manufacturers and installers; often includes out-of-state plants approved to ship in
format_access: Varies; NY publishes open data CSV/API
limitations: 50 different systems; start with CO and neighbors (WY; UT; NM; AZ; KS; NE; OK) plus top producing states

name: Colorado Innovative Housing Incentive Program (IHIP) awards
what_it_covers: Grants and loans to Colorado factory-built manufacturers: recipient; city; award; committed units
limitations: Units are commitments not completions

name: Colorado factory-built legislation and rules
publisher: Colorado General Assembly; State Housing Board
what_it_covers: SB25-002 (regional codes for factory-built; local parity); HB22-1282 (IHIP); DOH HUD-Code design criteria for Colorado placement
limitations: SB25-002 rules were due 7/1/2026 - check adoption status

name: Other states' policy scan
what_it_covers: Zoning parity for manufactured homes; factory-built incentives; ADU laws; mobile home park protections
limitations: Labor-intensive; define a fixed coding scheme first (see docs/data_dictionary.md)

name: American Community Survey 5-year
what_it_covers: Mobile homes (B25024); median household income (B19013); median home value (B25077); renter cost burden (B25070); population; housing units
limitations: Survey estimates with margins of error; tract MOEs can be large

name: HUD Income Limits (AMI)
what_it_covers: Area median income and 30/50/80% income limits
format_access: HUD User API (free token) or Excel
limitations: Metro-level values apply to all counties in the metro

name: HUD CHAS
what_it_covers: Housing problems and cost burden by income band (% AMI) and tenure
limitations: Lags ACS by about 2 years

name: Mobile home park locations
publisher: Federal (HIFLD) and state registries (Colorado DOLA Mobile Home Park Oversight)
what_it_covers: Point locations and lot counts of manufactured home communities
limitations: Verify current availability of the national layer; CO registry may need a records request

name: TIGER/Line boundaries and Gazetteer
what_it_covers: State/county/tract/place boundaries; place centroids used to geocode plants by city
limitations: None significant

name: Original manufacturer survey (CHRIS)
what_it_covers: Units shipped by destination state; product type; buyer type; price; capacity - the data no public source has for modular
limitations: Needs IRB review check; response rates; confidentiality - report aggregates only

name: CHFA Prop 123 Modular Finance + IHIP factory loans
publisher: Colorado Housing and Finance Authority (with OEDIT)
what_it_covers: Below-market factory loans to Colorado modular/factory-built manufacturers (Prop 123: $18M allocation in 2023; combined IHIP/Prop 123 guidelines 2025: loans up to $8M, 10-yr max); eligible products incl. modular, panelized, tiny, kit, ADU, 3D-printed
format_access: Program guidelines PDF; award lists via CHFA/OEDIT (records request if not published)
limitations: Award recipients and amounts not in the guidelines - compile separately

name: CHFA Qualified Allocation Plan (LIHTC)
what_it_covers: Scoring rules for 9%/4% LIHTC; 2027-2028 draft revises project-characteristics language on prefabricated/factory-built and modular construction
limitations: Draft as of 6/25/2026 - track final adoption; compare other Mountain West QAPs

name: FEMA National Risk Index
what_it_covers: Composite and hazard-specific risk incl. wildfire (expected annual loss; risk score/rating) and social vulnerability / community resilience
limitations: Modeled estimates; confirm version and field names on download

name: USFS Wildfire Risk to Communities (2nd ed.)
what_it_covers: Wildfire likelihood; exposure zones; risk to homes; tabular summaries by community/county/state; 30 m rasters
limitations: Large rasters; use tabular summaries for joins

name: Terner Housing Policy Simulator
publisher: Terner Center (UC Berkeley) / Terner Labs; used by CHRIS
what_it_covers: Projects housing production under policy scenarios using local market conditions and project financials (development cost per unit incl. land, construction, parking, fees, carrying costs); Denver is a covered city
limitations: Confirm with CHRIS which cost/timeline inputs can be adjusted for a factory-built scenario
